def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    divider = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    marker = 8
    bg = max((c for c in colors if c != divider), key=lambda c: colors[c])
    rows = [i for i in range(R) if all(grid[i][j] == divider for j in range(C))]
    cols = [j for j in range(C) if all(grid[i][j] == divider for i in range(R))]
    def segments(n, divs):
        segs, start = [], 0
        for d in divs:
            if d > start:
                segs.append((start, d))
            start = d + 1
        if start < n:
            segs.append((start, n))
        return segs
    rsegs = segments(R, rows)
    csegs = segments(C, cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in rsegs:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in csegs:
            cnt = sum(1 for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1) if grid[i][j] == marker)
            row.append(cnt if cnt > 0 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
